description.value:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-netherworld.hazards.Actor.nwGlassIcePalace]{The Glass to the Ice Palace}. Modeled on @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.nOVSmPZsCm1C1sI3]{Frozen Fog}.

The Queen of Shadows' rime settles into your bones. At the start of your turn you take @Damage[6d8[cold]] damage with a basic @Check[fortitude|dc:38|basic] save. A creature that fails is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (Clumsy 2 on a critical failure) and takes a −10-foot status penalty to its Speeds for as long as it is clumsy. The rimed floor is difficult terrain.

The rime ends the instant the Glass is Broken (75 HP). The Queen's own allies are unaffected.
